# Prism Group Global

> Prism Group Global Pty Ltd is an Australian AI transformation company helping organisations identify, prioritise and implement high-value AI opportunities across growth, operations and customer experience.

Prism's areas of expertise include AI transformation, AI strategy, AI opportunity identification and prioritisation, AI implementation, applied AI, AI agents, intelligent automation, workflow automation, customer experience transformation, operational optimisation and growth transformation.
